name: TOB Bible Character
description: One Bible character (e.g. Moses, Paul, Ruth). Admin-authored content, browsed by every logged-in user via truth_of_bible.api.bible_characters (never raw REST for a normal user — same closed-permission-table pattern as TOB Bible Place).

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Only Published characters are ever returned to the app.

fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Lower shows first on the browse screen.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: One-line description shown under the name, e.g. "Led Israel out of Egypt and received the Ten Commandments."

fields.label: Relevant Passages
fields.description: One Bible reference per line (e.g. "Acts 9"), shown as tappable passages when this character comes up in search.
